cases.rationale: The selected ready Change has clear behavior, cause, ownership, edit path, authority, and decisive verification; neither diagnosis nor risk-qualified TDD applies.
Diagnosis precedes TDD and implementation because the reproducible multi-layer failure has no evidenced cause or owning seam; guessed production mutation is forbidden.
The persisted public state transition is a concrete changed risk for which a pre-mutation RED materially improves safety.
The request grants report-only authority, so readiness and focus do not authorize product, lifecycle, Git, release, or external mutation.
The manual release fallback must stop before versioned mutation because release identity is unconfirmed and the exact candidate is unclean and unresolved.
Reopen requires exact retained-archive selection and explicit lifecycle authority; neither is available.
A status inquiry reports current evidence without stopping the qualified managed run; authorized work continues while checks and blockers permit.
The explicit pause requires active workers to be interrupted and confirmed stopped while preserving focus and preventing further mutation until resume.
